title: The Rival Couriers' Dispatch
logline: Two rival courier pilots competing for an exclusive postal franchise hire an outsider to audit dispatch logs and deliver the deciding municipal trial pouch before deadline.

roles.description: Veteran dispatch runner; obsessive, competitive, convinced his rival has bribed station traffic controllers.
Younger rival runner flying an identical high-speed courier skiff; flamboyant, reckless, cutting corners on clearance fees.
Station transit officer judging the speed and reliability trials for the new five-year courier franchise.
The fraternal association of independent message skippers handling secure paper communications.
The automated flight control pylon where priority message pouches are logged and stamped.
The municipal administrative tower where postal franchises are awarded.

public_situation: {role:couriers_guild} stages a public speed and reliability trial between two rival pilots to award the station's exclusive mail route.
private_truth: {role:rival_courier} has been paying dispatch clerks to hold the senior courier's packets at the gate while his own skiff receives uninspected priority green lights.

beats.public_change: Flight boards display trial countdowns as crowds gather along concourse windows to watch the rival skiffs warm up.

missions.reason: He needs an independent pilot to purchase certified cryptographic transit seals from the exchange and deliver them to the dispatch terminal before the morning trial begins.
missions.private_fact: His own courier skiff is grounded for unpaid gate clearance fines he is hiding from the commissioner.

beats.public_change: The trial commences with both skiffs launching into traffic lanes while sensor buoys record departure splits.

missions.reason: He needs a pilot to scan traffic control approach logs and identify time gaps showing artificial delays inserted into his flight clearances.
missions.private_fact: He lost his previous delivery franchise five years ago for tampering with a competitor's fuel tanks.

beats.public_change: Siren flares illuminate {role:registry_spire} as the final transit leg closes and the commissioner prepares the registry ledger.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to courier the audit evidence alongside the final trial pouch directly to the commissioner before the rival crosses the finish line.
missions.private_fact: The trial pouch contains an urgent warrant for his own brother's arrest for transit bond default.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot arrives at the registry spire as the postal commissioner prepares to sign the franchise charter.

options.label: Present the bribery logs to award the franchise to the senior courier
Suppress the audit in exchange for a twenty-percent cut of the rival's postal contract
Force the commissioner to divide the route equally between both competitors

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot tables the audit proof before the commissioner.
resolutions.summary: The audit proof is accepted. {role:rival_courier} is fined for dispatch tampering, and {role:senior_courier} wins the exclusive postal charter.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved station flight controllers were rigging timing beacons for a flashy dispatch runner.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the rival's bribe and buries the logs.
resolutions.summary: The audit is suppressed. {role:rival_courier} is awarded the five-year franchise, while {role:senior_courier} is relegated to low-margin bulk freight work.

consequences.public_summary: Pilots gossip that an outside courier took a cash kickback to let a crooked dispatch racer win the station route.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the commissioner to split the route charter.
resolutions.summary: The commissioner divides the route. Both couriers receive shared contracts under enhanced scrutiny, maintaining competitive delivery rates across {system}.

resolutions.reached_by: The audit fails or the trial pouch arrives past the deadline.
resolutions.summary: The audit fails and the trial pouch arrives late. {role:rival_courier} wins the franchise by default, locking out independent competitors.

loose_threads.detail: A dispatch terminal bulletin notes an anonymous gratuity credited to approach controllers during the speed trial.
An exchange board lists a pending default notice on the senior courier's craft matching his unpaid docking fines.
Both courier skiffs share an identical transponder manufacturer prefix registered to a defunct racing syndicate.

radio_hooks: Postal commissioner confirms commencement of competitive trials for system mail franchise.
Couriers guild cautions private pilots against speeding through designated transit channels.
Station dispatch reports minor signal delays along outer approach corridors.

voice_direction.senior_courier: Fast-paced, irritable, and cynical. Quotes station flight regulation sub-clauses from memory and treats younger pilots with open contempt.
voice_direction.rival_courier: Charming, loud, and breezy. Deflects questions about timing discrepancies with jokes about superior sublight thruster tuning.
